request.description: A session launches its target: the adapter has no attach.

target.description: What to debug, as `avenger view` takes it, relative to the worktree's root: a chart script, such as `charts/revenue.av.sql`; a cell of a Quarto document, as `report.av.qmd#2` or `report.av.qmd#LABEL`; or the statement at a line of either, as `charts/revenue.av.sql:12`.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the session's first stop, before any breakpoint.
